limitations: Repeatedly exposed Train; intervals descriptive, not independent validation.
75 labeled scorer weights match for B/E/F; F additionally learns unsupervised RBF centers/widths.
F is a smooth unconditional signed-log numerical curve plus original Final features, not the same conditional function space as B.
E matches length/count approximately; numerical scale, topic and joint-feature distributions can shift.
Existing template grouping covers only 98 multi-family questions; no new grouping search.
No additional model, language refit, 1730 prediction pairing, oracle or fusion.
